extracted.intended_audience: USPTO examiners, patent attorneys, patent agents, and patent practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance on matters decided by various USPTO officials, covering authority, petitions, delegation, and actions that require examiner or supervisory attention. This chapter enumerates topics and decision-making responsibilities within the Office.
